# Martin Ferret

> Martin Ferret is a French TypeScript expert focused on type-checking performance, a contributor to Microsoft's TypeScript DOM types, and Lead Content Owner for the JavaScript and TypeScript certifications at Certificates.dev.

Contact: mferret.pro@gmail.com. Last updated 2026-11-12. Full text of the key pages: https://martinferret.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Services
- TypeScript performance audit: measure type-checking time and memory on the team's real codebase, find the types and files that cost the most, deliver a prioritized fix list.
- TypeScript 7 migration: measure TypeScript 6 vs 7 on the team's project, check memory in CI, plan a safe migration.
- Type-checking budget in CI: budgets based on the compiler's counters, with a tolerance calibrated on the project, so a pull request can't silently slow the build down.
- Team training and workshops: advanced TypeScript and type performance, for Angular, React and Node.js teams.

## Key pages
- [Work with me](https://martinferret.github.io/hire/): TypeScript performance consulting for engineering teams: audits, TypeScript 7 migration, CI budgets, training.
- [Invite me to speak](https://martinferret.github.io/speak/): Bio, photo and talk abstracts for conference and podcast organizers.
- [TypeScript Performance Lab](https://martinferret.github.io/lab/): Reproducible experiments on TypeScript type-checking performance, with raw results.
- [Work](https://martinferret.github.io/work/): Pull requests and issue analyses in Microsoft's TypeScript repositories and other projects, with live GitHub status.
- [What's up TypeScript France](https://martinferret.github.io/meetup/): The free online TypeScript meetup in French that Martin runs.
- [About](https://martinferret.github.io/about/): Who Martin is, with links to every profile.
- [Devpreneur](https://martinferret.github.io/podcasts/devpreneur/): A French-language podcast about entrepreneurship for developers, co-hosted by Martin Ferret and Alain Chautard.
- [Writing](https://martinferret.github.io/writing/): Martin's articles on JavaScript and TypeScript, including those published on the Certificates.dev blog.
